scenarios.name: Restore a locked view after temporarily hiding its solid

scenario_steps.name: The MCAD Software has a part containing one visible solid body
an unlocked copied view is active
the user chooses Lock from the copied view context menu
the user chooses All Hidden from the copied view context menu
the solid body is hidden in the viewport
the copied view displays a lock indicator
the user activates the Primary view
the user activates the locked copied view
the copied view displays its active and locked indicators
